storyCards.headline: The Adventures Of Rain Dance Maggie: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Red Hot Chili Peppers's "The Adventures Of Rain Dance Maggie" reached #38 on the Billboard Hot 100. "The Adventures of Rain Dance Maggie" is a song by the Red Hot Chili Peppers, released as the first single from their tenth album I'm with You (2011).

It was their first single since "Hump de Bump" in 2007, and their first with new guitarist Josh Klinghoffer.

The song was released to radio on July 15, 2011, three days earlier than expected, due to an accidental release.

The song peaked at #38 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #38 on the Hot 100.
